question_or_proposition: For Cyanide, Total Recoverable at Outfall 001, do the 'Report' entries in all effluent limit columns establish that no enforceable numeric discharge limit applies for compliance comparison, and does the '1/Quarter (*1)' monitoring requirement apply only during periods when discharging occurs per footnote *1?
required_context: Outfall 001 is designated as Intermittent Flow in Section A.1.
source_locator: aztec/final_permit.pdf, page 3, part_i, Section A.1, DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table (cyanide row); footnote *1
notes: The nominated row pairs report-only limit cells with quarterly monitoring conditioned by (*1). Resolving limit type affects numeric exceedance evaluation (Purpose A); resolving the (*1) discharge condition affects whether monitoring was required and how absent results are classified (Purposes B and C).
